title: What is DevOps? Explained with Animals | DevOps & SRE Zero to Hero Day 1
description:
What is DevOps, really? Not a tool, not just a job title. In Day 1 of this free 100-day course, Ollie the Owl and friends explain DevOps as a culture, its 4 pillars, and how to answer "What is DevOps?" in an interview.

I'm Shivam Singh Verma, a DevOps & SRE engineer with 5 years of experience building CI/CD pipelines, running cloud infrastructure on AWS & GCP, and managing projects.

📺 Day 1 of 100 · DevOps & SRE Zero to Hero: a free course with a new episode every day at 8 PM IST.

🔑 What you'll learn
• Why DevOps exists: life before DevOps and the 10-day release
• A clear definition: DevOps is a culture that improves delivery
• The 4 pillars: automation, quality, monitoring, testing
• Automation in its simplest form: a deploy script with set -e
• A real-world story: how a pipeline stops a bad release
• A 30-second interview answer you can reuse

🧾 Cheat sheet (copy & practice)
cat deploy.sh
bash deploy.sh

🎤 Interview question: In your own words, what is DevOps? (culture + 4 pillars + one real example, under 30 seconds)

🧠 Quiz: Which is NOT one of the 4 DevOps pillars: Automation, Monitoring, Manual hand-offs, Testing? (answer in the comments, reveal tomorrow)

🐾 Cast: Ollie the Owl, Mitthu the Parrot, Bablu the Beaver, Gajju the Elephant, Ashtu the Octopus, Kukdu the Rooster and Kaalu the Crow.

📝 Homework: Write your own one-line definition of DevOps in the comments.
